1939-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2 if Lunarch Veteran is on the battlefield.
1939-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4488-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
4488-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 green Beast creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

6-5261-7290.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-5261-7290.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-5261-7290.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Does Machines.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

4770-5301-6006-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5231-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5231-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

803-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
803-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1456-5078-5434-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4316-5078-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

141-5100-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5100-6797.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-728-5258-5618-6121.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

907-1993-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
907-1993-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

2239-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1895-3375-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4871-5075-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5075-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4365-4772-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

876-4137-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Weaver of Blossoms from exile by paying {2}. It'll enter as Blossom-Clad Werewolf due to it being night.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3678-6698-6871-6879.description:
Cast Skull of Ramos by paying its mana cost.
When Skull of Ramos enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Skull of Ramos.
Activate Skull of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Skull of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

880-3470-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3129-3690-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-3690-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Sylvan Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1263-2267-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

1268-5115-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
1268-5115-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {4}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

2105-3487-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Combat Celebrant token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.. The token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

359-2781-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
359-2781-4605.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1430-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1430-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image has a power of at least 2.
1430-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirror Image and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirror Image to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirror Image by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

803-3661-5852.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
803-3661-5852.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Shield Sphere triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Shield Sphere spells, causing the nontoken Shield Sphere to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

2429-3193-4893.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3193-4893.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

3451-4050-4191-4784.description:
Cast Augusta from your hand by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Augusta, adding one mana of any color.
When Augusta dies, Death's Oasis triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Plargg from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1652-2136-5200-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
1652-2136-5200-5231.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Patron of the Arts with haste.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by sacrificing the Patron of the Arts tokens, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens die, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control.

4474-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Gilder Bairn.
4474-4687-4929.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanent(s).

1770-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
1770-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

508-1656-3121-4283.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.You control at least two additional creatures.
508-1656-3121-4283.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Marionette Master from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Marionette Master enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Marionette Master, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
With Marionette Master on the battlefield, activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing a Servo, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
The Servo dies, triggering Marionette Master, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Marionette Master's power.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2188-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2188-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature leaves the battlefield, triggering Flaming Fist Officer, putting a +1/+1 counter on Flaming Fist Officer.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1766-1978-2734.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

168-1734-5276.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter.
With Fiend Hunter's ETB trigger target Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder levaes the battlefield returning Oblivion Ring to play.
Target Fiend Hunter with the Oblivion Ring trigger.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield.
Leonin Relic-Warder targets Oblivion Ring exiling it under Relic-Warder.
Repeat steps 2-6.
